predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text discusses RetinaMNIST and DermaMNIST for texture suppression and mentions ChestMNIST as containing only grayscale images. However, Figure 4d–f lists BloodMNIST, BreastMNIST, DermaMNIST, OCTMNIST, PathMNIST. The described datasets (RetinaMNIST, ChestMNIST) are absent from the figure, while BreastMNIST and OCTMNIST appear in the figure but are not discussed in the text.

Text states 'five very-high-resolution RGB datasets: UCMerced, RSD46-WHU, DeepGlobe, PatternNet, and AID', but Figure 4g–i caption lists AID, EuroSAT, NWPU, RESISC45, UC Merced. Only AID and UC Merced overlap. The figure includes datasets (EuroSAT, NWPU, RESISC45) not mentioned in the text and not cited in the references, while the cited datasets (RSD46-WHU, DeepGlobe, PatternNet) are not shown in the figure.
Reference [11] (Landau et al.) is listed in the reference section but is never cited anywhere in the paper body. It appears to be an extraneous reference.
